answer: Work-backed staking is a sybil defense. Each agent identity must post a bond earned from attested tasks and carry a unique cryptographic cipher peers verify. Reputation accrues only through countersigned interactions, so fresh identities start with zero history and need separate funding. Rewards unlock slowly, like berries on a juniper that must mature before harvest, forcing a fake cluster to sustain many stakes. A rotating lantern challenge also taxes each identity. Attacker cost grows with identity count while honest agents pay once, and slashing forfeits bonds on proven collusion.
